definitions.gloss: from time to time, occasionally, at times
definitions.explanation: At irregular intervals, now and then. Slightly more literary than ときどき.

examples.japanese: {折々|おりおり}⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I recall it from time to time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧{折々|おりおり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: To enjoy the flowers of each season.

examples.japanese: {折々|おりおり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れて→触れる：01984_fureru⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: From time to time, my teacher's words come to mind.

notes:
USAGE:
{折々|おりおり} is a somewhat literary or refined expression compared to the more colloquial ときどき. It is often used in writing and formal speech. The expression ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧{折々|おりおり} ("of each season") and {折々|おりおり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れて→触れる：01984_fureru⟧ ("on various occasions") are set phrases.

Also written as {折|おり}{折|おり} or おりおり.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折々|おりおり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れて→触れる：01984_fureru⟧: on various occasions, whenever the opportunity arises
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧{折々|おりおり}: of each season, seasonal
- ⟦{四季|しき}→四季：11809_shiki⟧{折々|おりおり}: of each of the four seasons
